title: FeNOMS - in-storage processing on 3D FeNAND using hyperdimensional computing for MS spectral search
problem: Mass spectrometry spectral search is computationally intensive, requiring massive data transfers between storage and processing units. Traditional architectures suffer from memory bandwidth bottlenecks.
motivation: Processing data near storage using in-storage computing with efficient algorithms like hyperdimensional computing can dramatically reduce data movement and improve throughput.
method: FeNOMS implements hyperdimensional computing algorithms directly in 3D FeNAND storage hardware, enabling efficient similarity search for mass spectrometry data without moving data to external processors, leveraging the storage medium's processing capabilities.
key_novelty: First application of hyperdimensional computing for mass spectrometry search in 3D FeNAND in-storage processing architecture.
contributions: Hyperdimensional computing acceleration for MS spectral search
43× speedup through in-storage processing on 3D FeNAND
Demonstration of near-data processing feasibility for scientific workloads
limitations: The approach is specialized for FeNAND memory technology and hyperdimensional computing, limiting generalization to other storage technologies or search algorithms.
primary_theme: In-storage processing for biological data search
